question: Write a detailed explanation of section 4.1.1 “Malleability”, using the textbook evidence and supporting details.
answer: Collect some waste pieces of copper and aluminium, an iron nail, a piece of coal, a pea-sized lump of sulfur (gandhak), and a block of wood. Recall the chapter ‘Materials Around Us’ in the Grade 6 Science textbook Curiosity and observe the appearances of the above items. Are they lustrous? Also, note whether they are hard or soft and record your observations in Table 4.1.
